changed_in.5.2: A `%` followed by something the interpreter does not list as a conversion raises, a `%` at the very end of the format included. 5.1 checks nothing: it hands each `%` and the character after it to the host C library as they stand, and copies a trailing `%` through as a literal.
changed_in.5.3: `time` has to be a whole number inside the range a time value can hold; earlier versions accept any number and truncate a fraction. A moment the system cannot work out a date for raises instead of answering `nil`.
